# Rigby2D runtime (development study)

`src/core` and `src/webgl` from https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d,
tag `v0.3.0`, commit `6778d30a5337bb35e88c658d67292fc982599b05`.
Repository lint/format and final-newline normalization have been applied to the vendored JavaScript.

MIT OR Apache-2.0; both upstream licenses are included. No upstream demo artwork is included.

The development-only dweller study imports this runtime. It is excluded from production by the
DEV-gated route. `index.d.ts` describes only the API surface exercised by this experiment.
